name: MultiDDA
definition: Incremental DDA traversal over a 2-level hierarchical grid where the top grid contains bricks, and each brick contains an 8³ voxel sub-grid.
summary: MultiDDA is a ray traversal algorithm for sparse voxel grids that uses nested DDA loops to skip empty space efficiently by first traversing a coarse brick grid and then performing fine-grained voxel-level traversal.
